tenderSchedule.title: Procurement of Domestic coal - BTPS
tenderSchedule.description: PROCUREMENT, TRANSPORTATION AND SUPPLY OF 5.00 LAKH MT OF DOMESTIC COAL FOR BELLARY TPS OF KARNATAKA POWER CORPORATION LIMITED ON FIRM PRICE BASIS
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Chief Engineer Mines office Bengaluru

tenderAddress.blockNumber: No. 82, Shakthi Bhavan, Race Course Road

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per the tender document
All bidders are requested to quote their basic rates in Rs./MT for each item of the price schedule (exclusive of GST)
All bidders are requested to indicate relevant GST in percentage in appropriate place/window/fields for each item of price schedule in KPPP
All bidders are requested to peruse the tender document completely before submitting their bid/offer

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall have experience in procurement, transportation and supply of coal by Rail mode to any Thermal Power Station or any industrial unit in India for a minimum quantity of 2.50 lakh MT (i.e., 50% of contractual quantity) with a minimum contract value of Rs.240.00 crores through one or multiple contracts during in any one of the last five financial years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 and shall furnish relevant authenticated documents to establish proof of fulfillment as per format at Section -13 (a) - Schedule of Experience, duly filled, signed with seal of the Company. Tenderer shall furnish Performance Certificate / Work Completion Certificate as per proforma provided at Section - 13 (b).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work experience certificates along with relevant work orders/contract agreements

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall be financially sound and capable of executing high value contracts. As a proof of their financial capacity, the tenderer should furnish a firm and unconditional Letter of commitment for Rs.120.00 Crores (Rupees One Twenty crores only) from any Nationalized bank / scheduled bank / Branches of foreign banks in India valid for minimum of Twelve months, to meet the fund requirement for the procurement and transportation of domestic coal from a colliery in India and transportation of the same by Rail mode to the destination TPS, which shall be valid for a minimum of 12 months from the date of issue as per KPCL pro-forma at Section -16.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Letter of Commitment from the bank as per the proforma provided in the tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall in its name should have during the last five preceding years, i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial annual turnover of not less than Rs.960.00 Crores (Rupees Nine Hundred Sixty crores only) and shall furnish a copy of Audited Balance Sheets and Profit & Loss Account Statements duly certified by the Chartered Accountant along with a Certificate as per format in Section -15.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Profit and Loss statements and audited balance sheets duly certified by Chartered Accountant
